verdict.rationale: Anrok's API docs describe a createEphemeral endpoint for real-time tax estimation during checkout and a dedicated Address Resolution endpoint that normalizes a customer address to determine taxable jurisdiction(s), supporting rooftop-level (not ZIP-only) accuracy. However, there is no explicit performance/latency benchmark or independent hands-on confirmation that calls are fast enough for checkout-critical paths. Missing for 10: documented latency/SLA numbers for checkout use, independent/third-party verification of real-time performance, and explicit comparison against ZIP-code-level competitors.
